notes.title: 🎾 Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX – Officially Released Today! 🎉
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44790310/73621b8dff81df63500ea399dd84c664af943e2a.png[/img]

[b]Dear players,
[/b]

The day has finally come – Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX is now officially available on Steam!
After a long journey of development, we’re incredibly excited (and nervous!) to share this game with you.

We’ve been working on this title for a long time, and developing the tennis gameplay has been a major challenge. In fact, there were times when development got so rough that we considered giving up. But our passion for creating a unique and entertaining sports hentai game kept us going.
We hope you can feel the love and dedication we've poured into it.

[b]📝 If you enjoy the game, please help us by leaving a review!
[/b]
It really helps us improve the game, reach more players, and gives our small team a better chance to keep creating more awesome content in the future.
Your support truly makes a difference.

[b]Thank you for being here with us on release day.
[/b]
Now go meet your Tennis Angels! 💖

👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3099640/Academy_Love_Saga_Tennis_Angels_EX/

notes.title: Two coming soon games on October !!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

[h1]Happy Numbers[/h1] is a relaxing, mind-blending, minimalist puzzle game that offer over 70 hand-crafted levels to immerse your self into. 
The game also constain a lot of beautiful characters to unlock. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1418160/Happy_Quest/
[h1]Happy Quest[/h1] is casual match-3 game. 
You are a kind hunter. You quest is help the beautiful girls in the town. Let's make them happy.

- Added Brazilian - Portuguese localize language. 
Big thanks for Roberto 'Romegark' and Luis 'Di3sIrae' Scassiotti with community translation contributions. 

Cheer.
